newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Telecom's Pacific Star loses NZ$39.8 mln.
newsitem.headline: Telecom's Pacific Star loses NZ$39.8 mln.

text.p: Telecom Corp of New Zealand Ltd said its Australian offshoot, Pacific Star, lost NZ$39.8 million in the nine months to December 31 against an NZ$11.6 million loss in the comparable period a year earlier.
Telecom said it expected to provide between NZ$35-55 million for Pacific Star's losses.
It expects a formal plan of disposal or winding down of Pacific Star's businesses to be approved before March 31 at which time all losses expected from the winding down will be covered.
Telecom said the net book value of Pacific Star was NZ$22 million.
It said changes in the Australian regulatory environment meant Pacific Star no longer offered good opportunities for Telecom.
Telecom had moved to sell Pacific Star's major business line and was also moving to downsize the scope of the company's business.
In place of Pacific Star, Telecom had developed an Australian presence designed to service the needs of large corporate customers on both sides of the Tasman Sea.
